top_signals.title: Diamondback Agrees to Buy Double Eagle Assets for $5 Billion
top_signals.summary: Diamondback Energy Inc. agreed to buy certain subsidiaries of closely held oil driller Double Eagle for about $5 billion in cash and stock, growing its position as one of the largest operators in the world’s most productive shale patch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: NTT Docomo hit by another network glitch
top_signals.summary: The disruption began around 10:00 a.m., affecting the mobile carrier's 5G Standalone high-speed, high-capacity telecommunications network service.
